title: Baklava Walnut Honey Layers

seo.title: Walnut Baklava Recipe: Flaky Honey Layers

seo.imageAlt: Homemade authentic walnut baklava with honey syrup, garnished with pistachios.
seo.imageCaption: Indulge in the rich, sweet, and nutty flavors of our homemade Middle Eastern Walnut Baklava, perfect for any occasion.

description: Indulge in the classic Middle Eastern dessert, Baklava, featuring layers of delicate, crisp phyllo pastry. This recipe highlights a rich filling of finely chopped walnuts, generously soaked in a fragrant, sweet honey syrup. A true taste of tradition, perfect for special occasions or a delightful everyday treat.

instructions.title: Prepare the Honey Syrup
instructions.text: In a medium saucepan, combine 1 1/2 cups water, 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, and 1/2 cup honey. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce heat and simmer for 10-15 minutes until slightly thickened. Stir in the lemon juice and optional orange blossom water. Remove from heat and let it cool completely while you prepare the baklava. The syrup must be cool when poured over hot baklava.

instructions.title: Prepare Walnut Filling and Phyllo Dough
instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 325°F (160°C). In a bowl, combine the finely chopped walnuts, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, and ground cinnamon. Mix well. Melt the unsalted butter and set aside. Carefully unroll the phyllo dough and keep it covered with a damp cloth to prevent it from drying out.

instructions.title: Assemble the First Layers
instructions.text: Lightly brush a 9x13 inch baking pan with melted butter. Place one sheet of phyllo dough in the pan, gently pressing it down. Brush generously with melted butter. Repeat this process for 8-10 sheets of phyllo dough, buttering each layer. Ensure the phyllo extends up the sides of the pan.

instructions.title: Add Walnut Filling and Mid-Layers
instructions.text: Evenly spread half of the walnut mixture over the buttered phyllo layers. Place another 5-6 sheets of phyllo dough on top of the walnuts, buttering each sheet as before. Spread the remaining walnut mixture over these layers.

instructions.title: Complete the Top Layers
instructions.text: Cover the remaining walnut mixture with the rest of the phyllo dough sheets, typically 8-10 layers, buttering each sheet thoroughly. Once all layers are in place, brush the very top layer generously with melted butter. Trim any excess phyllo hanging over the edges for a neat finish.

instructions.title: Score and Bake the Baklava
instructions.text: Using a sharp knife, carefully score the baklava into diamond or square shapes, cutting all the way through the layers but not into the bottom of the pan. This helps the syrup penetrate evenly. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.

instructions.title: Pour Syrup and Garnish
instructions.text: Immediately after removing the hot baklava from the oven, slowly and evenly pour the cool syrup over the entire surface. The hot baklava will absorb the cool syrup, creating a wonderful texture. Let the baklava cool completely, preferably overnight, to allow the syrup to fully soak in. Garnish with ground pistachios if desired before serving.

tips: For truly flaky layers, ensure your phyllo dough is properly thawed and kept covered with a damp cloth throughout the layering process to prevent it from drying out and cracking.
While walnuts are traditional, you can experiment with other nuts like pistachios or almonds, or a mix, for a different flavor profile. Adjust sugar in the nut mixture to your preference.

For best results and to allow the syrup to fully absorb, let the baklava rest at room temperature for at least 4-6 hours, or preferably overnight, before cutting and serving. Store at room temperature in an airtight container for up to a week.
